answers.stem_only: Preventive control that binds member-account root users: an SCP at the organization root (or on the OUs holding the member accounts) that denies s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock. Detective plus corrective control for existing and future buckets: the AWS Config managed rule for S3 bucket server access logging, which evaluates all current buckets, with automatic remediation through the Systems Manager Automation runbook that turns bucket logging on. No custom Lambda code needed.
